name: Lejanías (Colombia)
description: Green field with a curved band of white and yellow running from the top edge round to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Lejanías, a municipality in the department of Meta, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: curved band from the top edge to the fly
